title: UK Regulatory Monitor
subtitle: FCA · PRA · ICO · CMA · FRC — enforcement, guidance, and rulemaking
schedule_note: Updated every 6 hours via GitHub Actions

items.title: PRA fines HDI Global SE £4,165,000 for inaccurate reporting of FSCS Liabilities and FSCS Fee Tariff data
items.summary: The Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) has imposed a financial penalty of £4,165,000 on HDI Global SE in connection with the submission of incorrect data to the PRA.

items.title: CMA response to consultation on swifter and simpler competition redress, regulatory appeals and competition enforcement
items.summary: Response by the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) to the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade's (BIST) consultation.

items.title: Regulators explore credit union reforms to support growth, innovation and better outcomes for members
items.summary: Credit unions could benefit from several ideas put forward today by the Prudential Regulation Authority and Financial Conduct Authority aimed at helping the sector grow, innovate and meet the changing needs of their members.

items.title: CMA response to consultation on equal pay and pay discrimination
items.summary: The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) response to the Office for Equality and Opportunity's consultation on reform of the current equal pay framework.

items.title: CMA response to consultation on consumer protection for home upgrade schemes
items.summary: Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) response to the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero (DESNZ) on consumer protection for home upgrade schemes.

items.title: Public procurement in the national interest: Reflections from the CMA
items.summary:
Opening remarks by Sarah Cardell, the CMA’s Chief Executive, delivered at the Parliamentary event with the Competition and Markets Authority,
Jubilee Room, House of Commons on 8 September 2026.

items.title: CMA secures compensation for heating oil customers
items.summary: Hundreds set to receive compensation after their orders were cancelled following the conflict in the Middle East.

items.title: Appointment of members of the Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC)
items.summary: Following an external recruitment process, the Bank of England has appointed Carlos Conceicao and Alexander Justham as members of its Enforcement Decision Making Committee, with effect from September 2026.

items.title: Appointment of Chair and Deputy Chair of the Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC)
items.summary: Following an external recruitment process, the Bank of England (the Bank) has appointed Nicholas Segal as Chair of its Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC), and Peter King as Deputy Chair, with effect from 1 August 2026.

items.title: PRA and FCA propose new captive insurance regime to drive UK growth and competitiveness
items.summary: Innovative new proposals aim to establish the UK as a centre for the fast-growing captive insurance market.

items.title: CMA fines firms £6 million for misleading sales tactics
items.summary: Customers will receive around £440,000 in refunds.

items.title: CMA opens investigation into Meta’s commercial terms
items.summary: Investigation will examine concerns that Meta’s terms and conditions unfairly harm news publishers and other content businesses.

items.title: Bank of England sets out approach to tokenised collateral in central clearing
items.summary: The Bank of England has today launched a consultation supporting central counterparties (CCPs) acceptance of tokenised forms of eligible collateral.

items.title: PRA consults on updated guidance for friendly society amalgamations and transfers
items.summary: The proposals would provide more detail on the PRA’s approach to Part VIII transactions, helping firms plan amalgamations and transfers more efficiently.

items.title: Green notice 2026/02
items.summary: Green notices cover significant and/or significant proposals for Bank of England reporting. If any of these proposals are finalised and are to be implemented, they will appear in a statistical notice.

items.title: Aldi and Lidl will be subject to same rules as major supermarkets
items.summary: CMA confirms Aldi and Lidl will be covered by the same land agreement rules as the UK’s other large supermarkets to ensure customers get the best choice of where to shop.

items.title: Guidance: Money Laundering Advisory Notice: High Risk Third Countries
items.summary: This document contains advice issued by HM Treasury about risks posed by jurisdictions with unsatisfactory money laundering and terrorist financing controls.

items.title: Guidance: OSCAR guidance for Budgeting (Plans and Outturn)
items.summary: Guidance on how to load data, review control totals and download reports for HM Treasury's OSCAR database.

items.title: The Bank of England, the Monetary Authority of Singapore, and the Bank of Thailand: Project Meridian FX APAC
items.summary: Joint media release

items.title: Bank rate increased to 4% - November 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
items.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.

items.title: Bank of England announces the four animals that will feature on our next series of banknotes
items.summary: The Atlantic puffin, barn owl, buff-tailed bumblebee and European hedgehog will represent UK wildlife and feature as the central images on our next series of banknotes.

items.title: Minutes of the London FXJSC Legal Sub Committee Meeting – 16 June 2026
items.summary: The Bank of England provides the Secretariat to the London Foreign Exchange Joint Standing Committee (FXJSC) Legal Sub-Committee. The FXJSC is made up of market participants, infrastructure providers and the UK financial regulators.
entities: London Foreign Exchange Joint Standing Committee

items.title: Minutes of the London FXJSC Operations Sub-Committee Meeting – 16 June 2026
items.summary: The Bank of England chairs the London Foreign Exchange Joint Standing Committee (FXJSC) Operations and Legal Sub-Committees. The FXJSC is made up of market participants, infrastructure providers and the UK financial regulators.
entities: London Foreign Exchange Joint Standing Committee

items.title: Minutes of the London FXJSC Main Committee Meeting – 24 June 2026
items.summary: The Bank of England chairs the London Foreign Exchange Joint Standing Committee (FXJSC), which is a forum for discussion of the wholesale foreign exchange market.
entities: London Foreign Exchange Joint Standing Committee

items.title: Minutes of the Market Participants Group meeting – 24 September 2026
items.summary: The Market Participants Group (MPG) is a senior-level forum for financial market participants to share their views on relevant themes and narratives in financial markets with members of the Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee.

items.title: Bank of England announces new office space in Leeds
items.summary: The Bank of England has secured a new long-term premises in Leeds, marking a major milestone in its commitment to build its presence in the region.

items.title: Minutes of the Transaction and Post-trade Reporting Harmonisation Taskforce - July 2026
items.summary: The Transaction and Post-trade Reporting Harmonisation Taskforce, through its three working groups, will help inform the design of the Bank and FCA’s long-term approach to harmonising UK MiFIR, UK EMIR and UK SFTR reporting requirements

items.title: Bank rate maintained at 3.75% - September 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
items.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.

items.title: Chancellor announces Bank of England appointments
items.summary: His Majesty the King and the Chancellor have appointed three new non-executive directors to the Bank of England’s Court of Directors
